title: Cosmic Aurora Goddess
description: A woman with closed eyes and intricate glowing tattoos on her face and body is depicted from the chest up, head tilted back. Her long flowing hair merges with the cosmos, containing two jellyfish and a large green praying mantis on the left, while a black serpent coils around her torso. The background shows a vibrant aurora borealis, floating dark rock fragments, and radiant beams of light.
prompt: A mystical woman with closed eyes and intricate luminous tattoos on her face, neck and chest, head tilted upward in bliss. Her long flowing hair blends into a cosmic night sky filled with vibrant aurora borealis in greens, purples and pinks. A large translucent jellyfish and a detailed green praying mantis emerge from her hair on the left, while a glossy black serpent with white markings coils around her body. Floating dark rock fragments drift through the sky with radiant beams of light breaking through, ethereal fantasy style, highly detailed digital art.
